qs.title: Apartment building notice about package lockers
ad: The building has installed a new set of package lockers in the main lobby. When a courier delivers a parcel that fits, the system sends a code to the resident's phone. The code opens only the assigned locker and works for twenty-four hours. Residents should remove the parcel before the code expires, because an uncollected parcel is moved to the manager's office the next morning. Oversized parcels still go to the office immediately, and the manager will leave a paper notice in the resident's mailbox. Please report any damaged packaging to the manager on the same day you pick up the item.

qs.title: The ecology of seasonal wetlands in dryland landscapes
ad: Seasonal wetlands are shallow depressions that fill with water for only part of the year. In dryland regions, where rainfall is low and unpredictable, these temporary ponds support a distinctive group of plants and animals that have adapted to the alternation between wet and dry phases. The biological communities of seasonal wetlands differ sharply from those of permanent lakes, because the inhabitants must complete their life cycles in the interval between flooding events. Many species respond to the arrival of water by emerging from drought-resistant eggs or by germinating from long-lived seeds, a strategy that allows populations to persist across years when the wetland never fills. The drying phase is equally important. As water levels fall, predators such as fish are excluded, and the remaining pool becomes a refuge for animals that cannot coexist with fish. The wet phase favours rapid growth and reproduction, while the dry phase favours dispersal and survival in resting stages. Because the timing of filling and drying is variable, species in seasonal wetlands often invest in broad tolerance rather than narrow specialisation. Conservation of these habitats depends on maintaining the natural hydrological cycle, including the periods of drying that are often disrupted by human water use. Restoring lost seasonal wetlands also requires reconnecting them to their catchments so that runoff can reach the basin during heavy rains.

qs.title: Library notice about weekend opening hours
ad: Starting this Saturday, the Whitfield Community Library will begin a trial of weekend opening hours. The building will open at 9:00 a.m. and close at 6:00 p.m. on both Saturday and Sunday for the next eight weeks. During the trial, the reading room on the second floor will remain closed on Sundays because of ongoing shelf repairs. The first-floor help desk will be staffed throughout the weekend, and members can request book returns, new library cards, and inter-branch transfers at that desk. Printed notices with the new hours are available near the entrance, and staff will hand out a short survey card to anyone who visits on Saturday or Sunday. The library hopes that the trial will show whether weekend visits are popular enough to become a permanent part of the schedule.
